# function
isLog2Transformed <- function(data) {
    qx <- as.numeric(quantile(data, c(0., 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.99, 1.0), na.rm = T))
    shouldBeLogged <- (qx[5] > 100) || (qx[6] - qx[1] > 50 && qx[2] > 0)
    return(!shouldBeLogged)
}

## A loop to download all the files in the .temp of this environment
for (i in 1:length(pd7$supplementary_file)) {
    url <- pd7$supplementary_file[i]
    destfile <- file.path(paste0(".temp/", id, "/", pd7$file[i]))
    # Download the file
    tryCatch(
        {
            download.file(url, destfile, mode = "wb", method = "curl")
        },
        error = function(e) {
            # Fallback to default method if curl fails
            download.file(url, destfile, mode = "wb")
        }
    )
    # Optional: Extract if it's a tar file
    if (grepl("\\.tar(\\.gz)?$", destfile)) {
        untar(destfile, exdir = paste0(".temp/", id))
    }
}

agilent_two_color_qc <- function(agilent_data,
                                max_probe_na = 0.1,  # 10% threshold for probes
                                max_sample_na = 0.1, # 10% threshold for samples
                                intensity_cutoff_quantile = 0.2, # Intensity cutoff
                                min_samples_above_cutoff = 0.2, # Minimum % samples
                                verbose = TRUE) {
    
    # 1. Input Validation --------------------------------------------------------
    required_components <- c("R", "G", "genes", "targets")
    missing_comps <- setdiff(required_components, names(agilent_data))
    if(length(missing_comps)) {
        stop("Missing required components: ", paste(missing_comps, collapse=", "))
    }
    
    # 2. Data Type Conversion ---------------------------------------------------
    if(verbose) message("\n=== DATA TYPE CONVERSION ===")
    agilent_data$R <- apply(agilent_data$R, 2, as.numeric)
    agilent_data$G <- apply(agilent_data$G, 2, as.numeric)
    if("Rb" %in% names(agilent_data)) agilent_data$Rb <- apply(agilent_data$Rb, 2, as.numeric)
    if("Gb" %in% names(agilent_data)) agilent_data$Gb <- apply(agilent_data$Gb, 2, as.numeric)
    
    # 3. Dimensional Consistency Checks ------------------------------------------
    if(verbose) message("\n=== DIMENSIONAL CHECKS ===")
    check_dims <- list(
        list(nrow(agilent_data$R), "R rows", nrow(agilent_data$G), "G rows"),
        list(ncol(agilent_data$R), "R cols", ncol(agilent_data$G), "G cols"),
        list(nrow(agilent_data$R), "R rows", nrow(agilent_data$genes), "genes rows"),
        list(ncol(agilent_data$R), "R cols", nrow(agilent_data$targets), "targets rows")
    )
    
    for(chk in check_dims) {
        if(chk[[1]] != chk[[3]]) {
            stop(sprintf("Dimension mismatch: %s (%d) vs %s (%d)",
                        chk[[2]], chk[[1]], chk[[4]], chk[[3]]))
        }
    }
    if(verbose) message("✓ All dimensions consistent across R, G, genes, and targets")
    
    # 4. Missing Value Analysis ------------------------------------------------
    if(verbose) message("\n=== MISSING VALUE ANALYSIS ===")
    na_stats <- list(
        R = list(
            probes = rowMeans(is.na(agilent_data$R)),
            samples = colMeans(is.na(agilent_data$R))
        ),
        G = list(
            probes = rowMeans(is.na(agilent_data$G)),
            samples = colMeans(is.na(agilent_data$G))
        )
    )
    
    combined_na <- list(
        probes = pmax(na_stats$R$probes, na_stats$G$probes),
        samples = pmax(na_stats$R$samples, na_stats$G$samples)
    )
    
    flagged <- list(
        probes = which(combined_na$probes > max_probe_na),
        samples = which(combined_na$samples > max_sample_na)
    )
    
    if(verbose) {
        message("Red Channel (R/Cy5) Missing Values:")
        print(summary(na_stats$R$probes * 100))
        message("\nGreen Channel (G/Cy3) Missing Values:")
        print(summary(na_stats$G$probes * 100))
        message(sprintf("\nFlagged %d probes (%.1f%%) exceeding %.0f%% NA threshold",
                      length(flagged$probes),
                      length(flagged$probes)/nrow(agilent_data$R)*100,
                      max_probe_na*100))
        message(sprintf("Flagged %d samples (%.1f%%) exceeding %.0f%% NA threshold",
                      length(flagged$samples),
                      length(flagged$samples)/ncol(agilent_data$R)*100,
                      max_sample_na*100))
    }
    
    # 5. Quality Control Processing --------------------------------------------
    if(verbose) message("\n=== QUALITY CONTROL PROCESSING ===")

    # Filter probes without gene symbols
    if(verbose) message("Filtering probes without gene annotations...")
    has_gene <- !is.na(agilent_data$genes$GB_ACC) & agilent_data$genes$GB_ACC != ""
    agilent_data <- agilent_data[has_gene, ]
    
    # Background correction
    if(verbose) message("Performing background correction...")
    agilent_data <- limma::backgroundCorrect(agilent_data, method = "normexp", offset = 1)
    
    # Within-array normalization (dye bias correction)
    if(verbose) message("Performing within-array normalization...")
    agilent_data <- limma::normalizeWithinArrays(agilent_data, method = "loess")
    
    # Between-array normalization
    if(verbose) message("Performing between-array normalization...")
    agilent_data <- limma::normalizeBetweenArrays(agilent_data, method = "quantile")
    

    
    # Average replicate probes
    if(verbose) message("Averaging replicate probes...")
    agilent_data <- limma::avereps(agilent_data, ID = agilent_data$genes$GB_ACC)
    
    # 6. Low-Expression Filtering ---------------------------------------------
    message("\n=== LOW-EXPRESSION FILTERING ===")
    # For two-color arrays, filter based on BOTH channels
    # Calculate average intensity (A-values) across arrays
    avg_intensity <- rowMeans(agilent_data$A, na.rm=TRUE)  

    # Set cutoff at 20th percentile of intensities
    cutoff <- quantile(avg_intensity, probs=0.2)  
    message("Intensity cutoff (20th percentile): ", round(cutoff, 2))

    # Keep genes above cutoff in at least 20% of samples
    keep <- rowSums(agilent_data$A > cutoff) >= ncol(agilent_data$A)*0.2

    # Apply filtering
    gse <- agilent_data[keep, ]
    gse$genes <- droplevels(gse$genes)

    message("\nFiltering results:")
    message("- Genes before filtering: ", nrow(agilent_data))
    message("- Genes after filtering: ", nrow(gse))
    message("- Percentage retained: ", round(nrow(gse)/nrow(agilent_data)*100, 1), "%")

    return(gse)
}

    ATL_AC = ATL - AC,

)

topprobes |>

    tidyplots::tidyplot(x = logFC, y = adp, color = sign) |>
    tidyplots::add_data_points(alpha = .5) |>
    tidyplots::add_data_labels_repel(label = GENE_SYMBOL, data = filter_rows(sign == "Sign"), color = "black") |>
    tidyplots::adjust_x_axis_title("Log2(Fold Change)") |>
    tidyplots::adjust_y_axis_title("-Log10(Adjusted Pvalue)") |>
    tidyplots::remove_legend() |>
